steps.en: Define the chart: marks over your original rows, plus x/y scales
steps.zh: 写图表定义：在原始数据上叠标记，再配 x、y 比例尺

component.zh: 语法层（标记、通道、比例尺）

steps.en: Infers scale domains from the channels and fits axes and margins to the container
steps.zh: 从通道推断比例尺范围，按容器尺寸排好坐标轴和边距

steps.en: Compiles a renderer-neutral scene of keyed shapes
steps.zh: 编译出一份与渲染方式无关、图形带键的场景

steps.en: Pass the same definition to your framework's Chart component
steps.zh: 把同一份定义交给所用框架的 Chart 组件

steps.en: Renders SVG on the server, hydrates, then follows resizes with tooltips and focus
steps.zh: 服务端出 SVG，浏览器水合，随后跟随尺寸变化并提供提示框和焦点

value.en: One typed chart definition that renders in any supported framework and on the server, without dropping to raw D3 for custom layers
value.zh: 一份带类型的图表定义，能在各支持框架和服务端渲染，加自定义图层也不用退回裸 D3
